scientific_question: Are exact-refinement failures in the released Skill-SP controller decomposable into two distinct representation channels—pre-feedback selection duplication and post-selection evidence/credit fragmentation—such that quotienting only one channel leaves the other defect intact and quotienting both restores the canonical semantic reference?

reference_state.semantic_feedback_multiset: eight identical focal-class records with p_hat=0.90 and consistency=true

factor_selection.native: Run the released sampling_weights over the split three-ID library; semantic focal probability is the sum of focal_a and focal_b identity probabilities.
factor_selection.quotient: Run the same released sampling_weights on the two semantic-class representatives (focal/background), then conserve that class probability when represented by focal_a/focal_b. Exact identity multiplicity may not change semantic-class selection mass.

factor_credit.native: Partition the same eight focal semantic feedback records deterministically 4/4 across focal_a/focal_b, run released per-ID stats update, then released per-ID prune gate; semantic class retires only if all exact member IDs retire.
factor_credit.quotient: Merge the same eight focal semantic feedback records at one semantic-class representative, run the same released stats update/prune gate once at class level, then project the class lifecycle decision to focal_a/focal_b.

cells.S_quotient__C_native: selection duplication repaired; per-ID credit/lifecycle unchanged

expected_selection_values.split_native_focal_semantic_probability: 2/3 under equal default per-ID released weights

primary_endpoint: 2x2 restoration pattern over two orthogonal invariance indicators: immediate semantic selection mass and post-feedback persistent semantic-class lifecycle decision
pass_gate: Canonical reference must be selection probability 0.5 and retired after eight frozen records. The four split cells must match the frozen restoration pattern exactly: native/native fails both; quotient-selection/native-credit fixes only selection; native-selection/quotient-credit fixes only lifecycle; quotient/quotient fixes both. Released source commit/functions/defaults must match and semantic feedback must be identical across credit cells.
stop_gate: Any mismatch in the 2x2 restoration pattern stops the two-channel mechanism decomposition. Retain R19 and do not rewrite the main paper around credit fragmentation.
after_pass: A PASS permits a paper-design-only R2 mechanism story draft and a natural-prevalence qualification plan. It still does not authorize LLM/agent/GPU experiments, task-utility claims, cross-system prevalence claims, or replacement of canonical R19.
claim_boundary: Deterministic controller decomposition on one released Skill-SP mechanism. It separates two representation channels but does not measure endogenous frequency, utility, or task-general behavior.
